KEGG-derived representation of the EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance pathway

KEGG-derived representation of the EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance pathway. Red-highlighted elements denote proteins predicted to interact with compound 3. The pathway outlines several mechanisms of resistance, including bypass signals mediated by ERBB2/ERBB3, activation of PI3K–Akt and MAPK signalling modules, and impaired apoptotic responses. These processes collectively influence cell proliferation, motility, and therapeutic resistance30–33
